thread:
alex.c: kicking off RFC: SDK defaults for retries/backoff + streaming reconnects. want to lock scope for next sprint. customers asking for clearer defaults and simpler streaming usage.

marta.p: 👍 need to decide minimal surface: sync retries, async streaming, hedging? and whether to expose retry knobs vs opinionated presets.

jason.l: customer ask from FinCorp: explicit per-call timeout + per-stream reconnect. their SRE flagged bubbling errors vs silent retries causing double-charge risk. CC @priya.s

priya.s: +1. add `idempotency_key` guidance in the PRD. also call out token-refresh during reconnect as a security edge case.

zane.r: proposal for v1 scope:
- presets: none / standard / aggressive
- per-request `timeout_ms` (client-side)
- streaming: auto-reconnect with `max_reconnects` and backoff (exp jitter)
- surface reconnect events via callback / event emitter
- docs + eval harness for billing/regression tests

alex.c: acceptance criteria draft:
- default preset recovers from ~95% of transient 503/429 with <=100ms median added latency
- streaming client reconnects transparently but emits reconnection events so app can detect replays
- include `idempotency_key` examples across SDKs and server-side expectations in docs
- telemetry: expose reconnection_count, retry_count, tokens_charged_estimate per-call

eric.t: platform note: hedging is a v2 feature. it requires router-side support and metrics instrumentation. can't be part of v1 GA.

nina.k: security items to include in PRD:
- do not log tokens; ensure token refresh flows over reconnects without persisting secrets
- require opt-in telemetry for collecting token/billing traces for beta customers
- test for expired token mid-stream -> ensure reconnect flow re-auths cleanly

oliver.m: customer-success request: provide a beta telemetry opt-in for FinCorp & MedAssist to collect retry traces + billed token deltas. this will help validate billing safety.

zane.r: edge cases to explicitly document:
- partial-response: server abruptly closes mid-stream. behavior: attempt reconnect only if server supports resume semantics or re-request whole response with `idempotency_key` and surface duplicate tokens risk
- client-cancel during reconnect -> should abort and not auto-retry
- non-idempotent tool-calls (webhook/sideload) must not be retried automatically; surface error to app

priya.s: acceptance tests (QA):
- chaos harness: inject 503/429/network flaps/token expiry and measure percent of successful recoveries and extra tokens charged
- billing-safety test: simulate replay and verify `idempotency_key` prevents double-charge in common cases
- telemetry validation: ensure reconnection events tie to request ids and token estimates

alex.c: rollout plan suggestion:
- RFC posted (this thread) -> ship spec PR week 1
- implement core (presets, timeouts, reconnect) week 2-3
- internal dogfood + stress tests week 4
- feature-flagged beta to 3 customers (incl FinCorp) week 5
- measure metrics (retry success rate, median extra latency, token-billing delta) -> GA week 8 if SLOs met

jason.l: small request: include minimal Node/Python examples showing `idempotency_key` + streaming reconnect handler in the docs. customers want copy-paste.

marta.p: ownership and next steps: zane -> impl, priya -> security & test plan, eric -> rollout infra, oliver -> customer beta coordination. i'll draft the PRD scope block and acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: created draft PR #482 in repo `sdk` (https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/482).

alex.c: thanks all. i'll add this scope block to the PRD and upload a lightweight spec with acceptance criteria by EOD.
